title: Multi-Entity Query Visualization
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Organizational Analytics
description: Step-through visualization that executes a multi-entity Cypher query one clause at a time against a sample organizational graph. Each step highlights the matched nodes and edges, marks the query lines being executed, and updates a table of candidate bindings until the final result rows are returned.

learningObjectives: Execute a multi-entity Cypher query and trace the traversal path through the organizational graph model
prerequisites: Cypher MATCH, WHERE, RETURN and ORDER BY
Node types and edge types of the organizational graph model

controls.label: Play / Pause
controls.description: Run or pause automatic playback of the seven steps

controls.label: Show Query
controls.description: Show or hide the Cypher query panel

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, then step through a worked example
keyQuestions: Which employees are candidates for e after each clause?
Which edges does the WHERE clause eliminate, and why?
Why is Carlos missing from the result?
commonMisconceptions: A daily contact in the same department still counts toward cross_dept_contacts
Every employee on the project appears in the result
assessmentOpportunities: Predict the candidate set before each step
Write and trace a modified query against the same graph
